themes.name: Acacia Afterglow
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Kenya. Umbrella acacias and open savanna in textured linocut, with acacia gold, burnt umber and dusty mauve. Golden afternoon and quiet dusk landscapes, with a transparent Editorial cover vignette.

themes.name: Aegean Paperlight
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Greece / Cyclades. Chalk stairways, coral bougainvillea and quiet island water shaped from torn paper. A transparent windmill-and-harbor vignette gives Editorial Home a luminous cover.

themes.name: After School Workshop
themes.author: Muqun Project
themes.description: A blue hour neighborhood workshop with a quiet bicycle, warm windows, and a place to begin.

themes.name: Akiba Overdrive
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: Violet streetwear, turquoise headphones, and delicate electronics-district watercolor. Wordless foreground art, separate quiet architecture, and restrained midnight light.

themes.name: Alpine Dispatch
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A lovable anime Shiba rescue companion above cinematic alpine valleys. Plush cheeks, sparkling eyes and rescue vermilion meet jade moonlight and amber beacons. Complete transparent dog illustrations and seven friendly rescue icons.

themes.name: Amber Relay
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Analog signal craft in amber, bakelite brown and warm bone. Screenprinted oscilloscopes, copper coils and glass valves now include a transparent Editorial cover vignette.

themes.name: Aperture Afterhours
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying rights reserved
themes.description: Unofficial Portal fan art. Quiet test chambers, blue and orange portals, and a Companion Cube in chalk white, chilled blue and afterhours slate. Clean spatial artwork, portal-shaped controls and a contained Home illustration.

themes.name: Atlantic in Azulejo
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Portugal / Lisbon. Hand-painted azulejo tiles, sunlit yellow trams and Atlantic swallows in porcelain white, saturated cobalt and lemon. A coastal ceramic world with nautical chrome glyphs.

themes.name: Atlas Foundry
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original industrial comic engineer beneath monumental iron arches. Ochre canvas, forest green and copper daylight meet graphite workwear and amber furnaces at night. Independent transparent portraits, complete launch figures and forged-line icons.

themes.name: Brasswing Skies
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A confident raccoon aviator and monumental brass airship harbor, illustrated in an original Western hand-drawn animation style. Warm daylight and lantern-lit charcoal, independent transparent launch vignettes, and seven bespoke airframe glyphs.

themes.name: Briar Oath
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A resolute auburn-haired knight in European comic ink, silver-sage plate and plum wool. Ancient briar forests and ruined stone arches unfold in forest gold and midnight plum.

themes.name: Cinder Canyon
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original western comic trail rider in rust canvas and turquoise cloth. Monumental red mesas, pearl desert daylight and deep umber starlight, with complete transparent launch art and seven custom trail-inspired glyphs.

themes.name: シティポップ・バルコニー
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: 海風、カセットテープ、夕暮れの色を重ねたシティポップテーマ。

themes.name: Clockwork Harlequin
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: An original chestnut-haired stage magician and his clockwork songbird welcome you to a miniature moonlit theatre. Cream, peacock blue and brass frame crisp anime illustrations, diamond ornaments and playful winding-key glyphs.

themes.name: Cloud Post Office
themes.author: Muqun · original artwork
themes.description: Send your thoughts beyond the clouds. An original anime-inspired post office with cloud-sea railways by day, starlit letters by night, and a paper-bird courier. Separate artwork for phone and wide-screen layouts.

themes.name: Cover Courier
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: Layered manga courier artwork over ivory or midnight railway paper. Transparent character art, quiet city wallpaper, and readable work surfaces.

themes.name: Cyber Miko
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A welcoming shrine attendant in ivory and vermilion watercolor, quiet garden scenery, and restrained midnight lantern bloom. Separate wordless artwork and wallpaper for both Home layouts.

themes.name: Cypress Hour
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Italy / Tuscany. Cypress avenues, olive hills and peach plaster villages in original fresco gouache. Olive dusk, sun-warmed peach and espresso frame a quiet landscape, with olive-twig, glider and cypress-loop glyphs.

themes.name: Deployment Atlas
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 composition; third-party logo licenses apply
themes.description: A DevOps blueprint with official Git, Jenkins and Bash marks on sparse perimeter nodes. Pale steel, deep petrol and lime guide a clear central workspace. Independent theme; not endorsed by the featured projects.

themes.name: Dual Transit
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: Two original manga couriers, vivid sunset railway streets and charcoal night. Dedicated close-up Home art, complete launch figures, and seven custom semantic controls.

themes.name: Echoes of Hallownest
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying game rights reserved
themes.description: Unofficial Hollow Knight fan art. A tiny Knight crosses silver mist and ink-dark caverns, with a transparent character scene composed for Classic and Editorial Home.

themes.name: Eclipse Archivist
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A silver-winged celestial archivist beneath a monumental eclipsed ringworld. Pearl and plum daylight, charcoal and silver night, complete semantic icons and restrained stars.

themes.name: Fern and Fiord
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: New Zealand / Fiordland. Rainforest ferns, ice-carved cliffs and silver waterfalls surround a transparent kayak scene composed for Classic and Editorial Home.

themes.name: Final Round
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection · fan art
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying rights remain with CAPCOM
themes.description: Street Fighter fan art in kinetic brushwork and screenprint: Ryu, vermilion ribbons, mustard ink and warm newsprint by day, oxblood after dark. The transparent fighter scene anchors Classic and Editorial Home.

themes.name: Firefly Heron
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A silver heron spreads luminous wings above a hand-painted Japanese wetland. Ivory and jade daylight become charcoal-green and firefly gold at night, with independent transparent launch art and seven feather-inspired icons.

themes.name: Gentian above the Clouds
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Switzerland / Alps. Snow peaks and cable cars rise above clouds in cut-paper relief, with a transparent mountain railway scene for Classic and Editorial Home.

themes.name: Glasshouse Prowler
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An adorable emerald-eyed anime kitten explores a grand botanical glasshouse. Expressive cel-shaded character art, independent transparent launch vignette, lush ivory and forest-charcoal worlds, and seven friendly botanical chrome glyphs.

themes.name: Harbor Nocturne
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original anime cellist at a cinematic working harbor. Vermilion, ivory and amber daylight become copper lights over warm charcoal at night. Complete transparent character art and an independent launch vignette.

themes.name: Harvest & Starlight
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection (fan art)
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying game rights reserved
themes.description: Unofficial Stardew Valley fan art. Honey-lit crops, cornflower skies and a cozy chicken-and-Junimo farm vignette in crafted 2D pixel art. Plum starlight, quiet reading surfaces and harvest-inspired glyphs.

themes.name: 紫陽花の窓辺
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: 梅雨の窓辺に咲く紫陽花と柔らかな光を閉じ込めた静謐なテーマ。

themes.name: Ink over Jiangnan
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: China / Jiangnan. Willow-lined canals and whitewashed water towns in rice-paper ivory, charcoal ink and cinnabar. Original ink-wash day and moonlit scenes, with brush, kite and scroll glyphs.

themes.name: Interface Playground
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A luminous frontend canvas with official HTML5, CSS and JSConf JavaScript marks at the perimeter, ultramarine actions and coral details.

themes.name: Jade Tempest
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A storm summoner and jade dragon above a monumental mountain kingdom. Ivory, bronze and emerald by day; luminous jade over pine charcoal at night.

themes.name: Jasmine at Dusk
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Thailand / Chiang Mai. Lanna teak houses, ivory jasmine and mulberry silk woven into an embroidered garden. Peacock teal, soft ivory and old gold frame a quiet evening, with ribbon and weaving-inspired glyphs.

themes.name: 雨上がりの喫茶店
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: 濡れた窓、琥珀色の珈琲、深緑のソファを映す静かな喫茶店テーマ。

themes.name: Lanterns in the Overworld
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying Minecraft rights reserved
themes.description: Unofficial Minecraft fan art. A mossy voxel forest and lantern-lit timber shelter, with warm clay, amber and smoky woodland palettes. Steve and a friendly wolf welcome you home.

themes.name: Last Inning
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original anime pitcher under immense stadium skies. Emerald, terracotta and ivory daylight becomes charcoal green beneath warm floodlights. Independent transparent portrait and full-length launch art, with diamond-inspired icons.

themes.name: Last Light in Lofoten
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Norway / Lofoten. Russet fishing cabins and storm-slate fjords in a tactile Nordic woodcut, with pale peach afterglow and nautical navigation marks.

themes.name: Lucid Encore
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: An original star DJ conducts holographic sound ribbons through a lucid rhythm dream. Periwinkle daylight, ink-plum night and rose-gold accents frame delicate anime artwork, with ribbon, shooting-star and music-note glyphs.

themes.name: Maple Kite
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An intrepid red panda kite keeper above a grand autumn canyon. Ink-detailed fur, sculptural paper sails and maple-gold cliffs turn into copper lanterns over a warm charcoal night.

themes.name: Midnight Operator
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Charcoal, pale celadon and phosphor green. Quiet etched circuit paths and a folded ceramic module bring an understated electronic atmosphere to focused conversations and terminal sessions.

themes.name: 渋谷、午前零時
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: ネオンと雨粒が交差する、午前零時の渋谷を描いた夜景テーマ。

themes.name: Mist above Alishan
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Alishan landscape. Layered tea terraces, cypress forests and a winding mountain railway in tea olive, mist white and apricot. Original paper-cut day and night scenes with tea-leaf and railway-ticket glyphs.

themes.name: Moon Jar Courtyard
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Korea. A white porcelain moon jar in a quiet hanok courtyard, rendered as layered hanji paper collage in porcelain, lilac and aubergine. Day and moonlit artwork with roof-eave, folded-crane and knot-paperclip glyphs.

themes.name: 宮本武蔵｜空の巻
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: 『五輪書』と二天一流をモチーフに、和紙、松煙墨、錆朱、夜藍で静かな緊張と余白を描く宮本武蔵テーマ。

themes.name: Mushroom Daybreak
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection · fan art
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying IP rights reserved
themes.description: Unofficial Super Mario fan art. Pixel landscapes in brick red, sky blue and butter cream, with midnight cobalt evenings and a transparent castle hero composed for Classic and Editorial Home.

themes.name: Neon Pellet Run
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying game rights reserved
themes.description: Unofficial Pac-Man fan art. Electric yellow, violet maze paths and midnight ink recall the vector arcade, with a quiet pellet trail and familiar round characters.

themes.name: Northstar Keeper
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A kind polar bear lighthouse keeper guides the way through arctic seas. Ivory ice, teal daylight and brass lanterns give way to charcoal auroras. Original Western animation character art, an independent launch pose and seven nautical icons.

themes.name: Obsidian Titan
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original silver-haired pilot and colossal volcanic guardian. Basalt armor, vivid caldera landscapes, ember accents and complete angular controls.

themes.name: Ocarina of Dawn
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying IP belongs to Nintendo
themes.description: Unofficial Zelda-inspired fan art: a blue ocarina and mossy sword pedestal among watercolor forest ruins. Mist, sage and pale gold meet deep woodland surfaces, with leaf-and-hook glyphs and a calm day/night terminal palette.

themes.name: One Piece — Grand Voyage
themes.author: Muqun custom theme · fan art
themes.license: Unofficial fan art, no rights granted -- see CREDITS.md
themes.description: Unofficial One Piece ocean-adventure fan art: turquoise seas, moonlit navy and straw-hat gold, with a contained Luffy Home illustration and nautical rope-and-sail glyphs.

themes.name: Orbital Console
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Aerospace white, midnight navy and safety orange frame sculptural orbital hardware. Ceramic modules, docking rings and solar wings leave a clear center, with spacecraft-inspired template icons and a complete terminal palette.

themes.name: Papyrus on the Nile
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Egypt / Nile Valley. Ivory felucca sails cross lapis water beneath copper desert ridges. Papyrus-inspired gouache pairs warm paper surfaces with a deep mineral night, reed arrows and scroll-shaped attachments.

themes.name: Paris, After the Rain
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: France / Paris. Art Nouveau ironwork, limestone facades and a rain-washed Seine in champagne, burgundy and antique gold. Original illustrated day and evening scenes, composed separately for phone and wide screens.

themes.name: Pocket Companion
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: An original little otter companion in oat, cocoa and apricot. Responsive Home artwork, tactile paper illustrations and soft rounded glyphs make a quiet place for everyday conversations.

themes.name: Pomegranate Court
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Spain / Granada. Terracotta arcades, aubergine evenings and turquoise water, with pomegranate gardens, ceramic geometry and courtyard-inspired glyphs.

themes.name: Quiet Terminal
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Graphite, fog blue and soft white. A restrained terminal-inspired palette with precise return, prompt and bracket-paperclip glyphs, and a small folded-metal still life for empty states.

themes.name: レインコート・クーリエ
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: 黄色いレインコートで雨の街を駆ける、軽快なアーバンテーマ。

themes.name: Rainline District
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Rain gathers on elevated tracks above a sleepless concrete city. Petrol haze, wet asphalt and coral signal lights shape a cinematic cyber-noir workspace from dawn to midnight.

themes.name: Reef Reverie
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original anime diver and her manta companion explore a luminous coral cathedral. Pearl and reef jade daylight give way to black-green bioluminescence, with dedicated launch artwork and seven bespoke nautical icons.

themes.name: Rhythm of Dessau
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Germany / Dessau. Glass grids and architectural rhythm in concrete white, graphite, vermilion and signal yellow. Original modernist screenprints with stepped navigation, a triangular glider and tubular-steel attachment glyphs.

themes.name: Ribbon Reverie
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: A ribbon performer invites you into a miniature fairy-tale theatre. Peach satin, raspberry curtains and champagne stars bring a graceful carnival daydream to light and mulberry-dark workspaces.

themes.name: リソグラフの夏祭り
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: 朱、群青、生成りの版ずれで夏祭りの熱気を描くリソグラフテーマ。

themes.name: Runtime Foundry
themes.author: Muqun Community; Go Gopher: Renee French; Python: PSF; Rust: Rust Foundation
themes.license: CC-BY-4.0; Python logo under PSF trademark terms; see source CREDITS.md
themes.description: A warm backend workshop: Python, the Go Gopher and Rust on precisely spaced ivory modules, with aubergine planes and copper connections.

themes.name: Saffron under the Atlas
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Morocco. Earthen kasbahs, palm oases and distant Atlas peaks woven in saffron, clay pink and midnight indigo. Quiet textile landscapes pair with ribbon, flying-carpet and woven-loop glyphs.

themes.name: Sakura, in Passing
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Japan / Himeji. Cherry blossoms and a white castle in blush, crimson and ink indigo. Original woodblock-inspired day and moonlit illustrations, with folding-fan, heron and mizuhiki glyphs.

themes.name: Scene Voyager
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: Vermilion city streets and indigo orbit. Large manga Home artwork, complete bicycle and astronaut launch compositions, cream work surfaces, and familiar semantic controls.

themes.name: Silver on the Neva
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Russia / Saint Petersburg. Frosted ironwork and Neva river ice rendered in silver engraving, icy cyan and deep cobalt. Day and moonlit illustrations with crystalline navigation and wrought-iron attachment glyphs.

themes.name: Soft Machines
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Pearl resin, mint silicone and smoky lilac glass form a quiet world of rounded frosted mechanisms. Original soft 2.5D sculptures, pearl light and violet dusk palettes, and smooth capsule-shaped control glyphs.

themes.name: Solar Cathedral
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original celestial knight above a monumental sunlit cathedral. Ivory and antique gold by day, charcoal and eclipse gold by night. Independent launch art and transparent Home foreground.

themes.name: Spore Protocol
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Porcelain biotech and luminous mycelium form a quiet alien macro-world. Ultraviolet shadows, chartreuse spores and pale ceramic surfaces pair with organic directional glyphs.

themes.name: Sugar Circuit
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: An original peach-haired arcade heroine in a candy-plastic cyber world, with a transparent editorial masthead and separate Classic hero framed by raspberry, ice cyan and milk-white surfaces.

themes.name: Sulfur and Silence
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Iceland imagined as a mineral monotype: basalt columns, sulfur shores and lilac geothermal steam. Chalk daylight gives way to volcanic charcoal, with faceted stone and rising-steam glyphs.

themes.name: Terraces of the Sun
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Peru / Andes. Curving agricultural terraces and mineral rivers become a woven landscape in quinoa cream, oxblood and turquoise, with day and night mountain light and terrace-inspired glyphs.

themes.name: Tetromino Atelier
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying rights reserved
themes.description: An unofficial Tetris-inspired geometric study: cobalt, tangerine and lemon blocks arranged as matte sculptures on warm white and deep graphite. Crisp stepped forms leave generous room to work.

themes.name: The Last Reading Room
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: United Kingdom / London. An oak-lined reading room in tobacco, parchment and brass, with Arts and Crafts foliage, rain-lit windows and original book-inspired glyphs.

themes.name: Lanterns on the Thu Bon
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: Vietnam / Hoi An. Silk lanterns, ochre shophouses and wooden river boats in jade, rice-paper ivory and cinnabar accents. Original silk-and-lacquer-inspired day and evening illustrations for phone and wide screens.

themes.name: Tidal Observatory
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: An original ocean researcher listens for luminous sky whales above a sea-glass observatory. Cinematic anime, pearl daylight and evergreen night, complete foreground silhouettes and quiet ocean air.

themes.name: Tiny Workshop
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: A miniature robot repair studio in concrete, tool blue and warm copper. Handcrafted benches, tiny drawers and patient mechanics gather at the edge of a quiet workspace.

themes.name: Urban Sentinel
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: Sage technical outerwear and warm graphite ink above peaceful botanical rooftops. One natural watercolor portrait, quiet independent scenery, and subtle evening particles.

themes.name: Vanguard Drifter
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: Ivory technical outerwear and burnt-orange details over quiet architectural paper. One expressive watercolor foreground, independent rail-city scenery, and calm solid work surfaces.

themes.name: Vector Vixen
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.description: An original silver-haired fox-helmet courier in acid lime, gunmetal and titanium. Sharp anime cel shading and racing geometry frame focused surfaces, with character banners, mechanical glyphs and a complete day/night terminal palette.

themes.name: Velocity Coast
themes.author: Muqun Theme Collection
themes.license: Unofficial fan art; underlying Sonic rights belong to SEGA
themes.description: Unofficial Sonic the Hedgehog fan art. Cobalt surf, coral cliffs and sweeping coastal loops in crisp kinetic comic illustration. Bright coastal daylight and deep marine night with speed-fin and track-loop glyphs.

themes.name: Velvet Signal
themes.author: Muqun
themes.description: A sharp-eyed noir detective in a monumental Art Deco rain city. Bold Western comic ink, plum tailoring and copper signals meet rose-ivory daylight and amber night. Independent transparent launch art and seven original Deco icons.
